description: A Military Operation where routine operational contact and interaction between individuals or elements of a countries armed forces and those of another nations armed forces, or foreign and domestic civilian authorities or agencies to build trust and confidence, share information, coordinate mutual activities, and maintain influence.

name: Military Exercise
description: An Act of Training conducted by a Military Unit that simulates wartime operations involving planning, preparation, and execution that is carried out for the purpose of training and evaluation.

name: Military Maneuver
description: An Act of Military Force in which a unit employs forces within an operational area, through movement in combination with fires and information, to achieve a position of advantage in respect to the enemy.

name: Military Operation
description: An Act of Military Force that has a sequence of tactical actions with a common purpose or unifying theme.

name: Military Strike
description: An Act of Military Force that involves an attack to damage or destroy an objective or capability.

name: Missile Launch
description: An act of departure that initiates the flight of a precision-guided missile.

name: Named Military Operation
description: A Military Operation carried out at the strategic or operational levels and given an identifying title or name.

name: Noncombatant Evacuation Exercise
description: A military exercise to simulate operations whereby noncombatant evacuees are evacuated from a threatened area abroad, which includes areas facing actual or potential danger from natural or manmade disaster, civil unrest, imminent or actual terrorist activities, hostilities, and similar circumstances.

name: Noncombatant Evacuation Operation
description: A military operation whereby noncombatant evacuees are evacuated from a threatened area abroad, which includes areas facing actual or potential danger from natural or manmade disaster, civil unrest, imminent or actual terrorist activities, hostilities, and similar circumstances.

name: Peace Exercise
description: A Military Exercise where all the instruments of national power with military missions to contain conflict, redress the peace, and shape the environment to support reconciliation and rebuilding and facilitate the transition to legitimate governance.

name: Peace Operation
description: A Military Operation involving all the instruments of national power with military missions to contain conflict, redress the peace, and shape the environment to support reconciliation and rebuilding and facilitate the transition to legitimate governance.

name: Security Cooperation Exercise
description: A military exercise that simulates interactions with foreign security establishments to build security relationships that promote specific United States security interests, develop allied and partner nation military and security capabilities for self-defense and multinational operations.

name: Security Cooperation Operation
description: A military operation with foreign security establishments to build security relationships that promote security interests, develop allied and partner nation military and security capabilities for self-defense and multinational operations.

name: Space Launch
description: An act of departure that initiates a larger transportation event from the surface of the Earth to outer space.

name: Stability Exercise
description: A Military Exercise that is conducted outside the United States in coordination with other instruments of national power to maintain or reestablish a safe and secure environment and provide essential governmental services, emergency infrastructure reconstruction, and humanitarian relief.

name: Stability Operation
description: A Military Operation conducted in coordination with other instruments of national power to maintain or reestablish a safe and secure environment and provide essential governmental services, emergency infrastructure reconstruction, and humanitarian relief.

name: Agency
description: An Organization Echelon of a government body assigned to perform specific functions, often supporting military operations and national security.

name: Air Army
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that is a large operational-level formation usually within the Russian Air Force.

name: Air Force
description: An Armed Force that primarily conducts military operations in the air domain.

name: Aircraft Squadron
description: A military or paramilitary echelon where the bearer uses aircraft, most often associated with a Air or Naval Force. An Air Force squadron usally consist of two or more flights. Generally the lowest level of command with a headquarters element, usually identified by number and function, normally commanded by a Major or a Lieutenant Colonel, depending on the country.

name: Armed Force (Defense Intelligence)
description: A Military Organization that is armed, organized, and trained to conduct military operations.

name: Army
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that is a tactical and administrative military unit usually consisting of a headquarters, one or more corps, and attached non-divisional troops and agencies.

name: Army Group
description: A military or paramilitary echelon usually consist of three or more field armies, with about 1 million to 3 million soldiers, usually commanded by a General, depending on the country.

name: Army Region
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground Force, usually consists of four or five field armies. Normally commanded by a General, depending on the country.

name: Battalion
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with Ground or Marine Forces, usually consisting of three to six companies and normally commanded by a Lieutenant Colonel, depending on the country.

name: Battery (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force artillery unit, usually consisting of six gun crews, together with the artillerymen, equipment, etc., required to operate them. Normally commanded by a Captain or Major depending on the military branch or country.

name: Border Guard Force
description: An Armed Force that is a distinct border guard force separate from an army.

name: Brigade
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually consisting of three to six battlions, normally commanded by a Colonel, depending on the country.

name: Center (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that operates a station that is part of a nation's missile defense network.

name: Coast Guard Force
description: An Armed Force employed in guarding a coast or responsible for the safety, order, and operation of maritime traffic in neighboring waters.

name: Company (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually consists of three or four platoons and is generally commanded by a captain or a Major, depending on the military branch, speciality unit and country.

name: Corps (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually consists of two to five divisions. Normally commanded by a lieutenant general depending on the country.

name: Crew (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually consists of two to four military members. Normally commanded by Junior Noncommissioned Officer.

name: Cyber Force
description: An Armed Force that conducts military operations in the Cyberspace domain.

name: Department (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that usually refers to the sub-divisions of a ship crew.

name: Detachment
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually consists of three or four platoons and is generally commanded by a Captain, depending on the military branch, speciality unit and country.

name: Directorate (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that is a subdivision of a district roughly equivalent in size and composition to a corps.

name: Division (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually consists of three or four brigades or regiments. Normally commanded by a Major General, depending on the country.

name: act of surveillance
description: An act of intelligence gathering by means of systematic observation of aerospace, cyberspace, surface, or subsurface areas, places, persons, or things, by visual, aural, electronic, photographic, or other means.

name: Field Army
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground Force, usually consists of two or more corps. Normally commanded by a General or Lieutenant General, depending on the country.

name: Flight (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon composed of between two and six (but most often four) aircraft and their aircrews and ground staff.

name: Flotilla
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Naval Force, usually consisting of two or more squadrons of small warships. Normally commanded by a Rear Admiral, a Commodore or a Captain depending on the importance of the command or country.

name: Front (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground Force, usually it is roughly equivalent to an Army Group varying in size but generally contains three to five armies depending on the country.

name: Ground Force
description: An Armed Force trained for war especially on the land domain.

name: Group (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Air Force or Ground Force, that usually consists of two or more Air Force squadrons or Ground Force Battlions, normally commanded by a Colonel, depending on the country.

name: Insurgent Force
description: An Armed Force that is an organized movement aimed at the overthrow of a constituted government through the use of subversion and armed conflict.

name: Internal Security Force
description: An Armed Force that is a distinct internal force separate from law enforcement.

name: Joint Force
description: An Armed Force comprised of military personnel and units from more than one Armed Force.

name: Major Command
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that is a major subdivision of an Air Force.

name: Marine Force
description: An Armed Force that primarily conducts amphibious military operations on land and at sea.

name: Merchant Marine
description: A military support organization that serves as an merchant shipping auxilary to a country's Military Organization.

name: Military District
description: A military or paramilitary echelon formed for the control and administration of a territorial subdivision of military forces.

name: Military Echelon
description: An Organization Echelon describing operational level and general size of a military organization.

name: Electronic Attack
description: An act of military force in which electromagnetic energy, directed energy, or antiradiation weapons are used to attack personnel, facilities, or equipment with the intent of degrading, neutralizing, or destroying enemy combat capability

name: Military Member Grade
description: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that depicts the hierarchical arrangement of military personnel, according to grade, authority, and responsibility.

name: Military Member Rank
description: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that denotes a level of authority and responsibility associated with a particular position or grade within the Armed Forces.

name: Military Organization
description: An Organization that is functionally organized to provide command and control, planning, support, or combat capabilities.

name: Military Staff
description: A Military Organization consisting of those personnel assigned to assist a commander in planning, coordinating, and supervising the execution of military operations or functions.

name: Military Staff Function
description: A function whereby those personnel assigned to a staff, assist a commander in planning, coordinating, and supervising the execution of military operations or functions of a unit to which it is assigned and its subordinate unit.

name: Military Staff Role
description: A role whereby those personnel assigned to a staff, assist a commander in planning, coordinating, and supervising the execution of military operations or functions of a unit to which it is assigned and its subordinate unit.

name: Military Support Organization
description: A Military Organization that assists, protects, or supplies other forces for the conduct of military operations.

name: Multi National Coalition Force
description: An Armed Force that is comprised military personnel and units from Armed Forces from more than one nation.

name: Launch Event
description: An act of departure which initiates the movement of a projectile or self-propelled craft through the air or water.

name: NATO Force
description: A Multi National Coalition Force under the command and control of NATO.

name: National Department
description: A Military Echelon that is a major subdivision of the executive branch of the US Government.

name: Naval Fleet
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Naval Force, usally the largest formation of warships. Normally commande by an Admiral.

name: Naval Force
description: An Armed Force that primarily conducts military operations in the maritime domain.

name: Numbered Air Force
description: A military or paramilitary echelon where air wings, squadrons and groups can all be assigned, which usually has a geographical assignment.  A numbered air force is usually commanded by a Major General or Lieutenant General, depending on the country.

name: Organization Echelon
description: A quality describing the operational level and general size of an organization.

name: Paramilitary Force (Defense Intelligence)
description: A Military Organization that is a group of armed individuals who are organized, trained, equipped, and conduct military-style operations, but who are not part of a regular armed forces establishment and whos activity is distinct from the lawful exercise of a state's police powers.

name: Platoon
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Air Force, usually consists of a few squads and up to a few dozen soldiers. Normally commanded by a Lieutenant, often with a Noncommissioned Officer as second in command, depending on the country.

name: Regiment
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually consisting of three to six battlions, normally commanded by a Colonel, depending on the country.

name: Rocket Force
description: An Armed Force that conducts military operations involving rockets and missiles.

name: Section (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon usually consists of two or more military members. Normally commanded by a Junior to Senior Noncommissioned Officer depending the number of service member, military branch or country.

name: Service (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that characterizes a specific echelon within a military organization, representing one of the branches of an armed force.

name: Ships Company
description: A naval force most often associated with a Naval Force that is created and organized to operate and maintain a specific Naval Vessel, usually commanded by a Naval Captain.

name: Space Force
description: An Armed Force that conducts military operations in outer space.

name: Squad
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually two to three teams are assigned to a squad, normally commanded by a mid level Noncommissioned Officer depending on the military branch and country.

name: Task Force
description: A military or paramilitary echelon that formed to accomplish a specific mission or task.

name: Team (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually includes three service members and a team leader, usually a Junior Noncommissioned Officer depending on military branch or country.

name: Troop
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Ground or Marine Force, usually is the equivalent echelon to a section or platoon. Normally commanded by a Lieutenant or a Senior Noncommissioned officer depending on the military branch and country.

name: Watercraft Squadron
description: A military or paramilitary echelon whose bearer uses watercraft, most often associated with a Naval Force. A Naval Force squadron is a significant group of warships which is normally considered too small to be designated a fleet. A squadron is typically a part of a fleet. Between different navies there are no clear defining parameters to distinguish a squadron from a fleet, nor the size and strength of a naval squadron varies greatly according to the country and time period. Since the size of a naval squadron varies, the rank associated with command of a squadron also varies.

name: Wing (Military Echelon)
description: A military or paramilitary echelon most often associated with a Air Force, usually comprised of two or more groups, usually commanded by a Colonel or Brigadier General, depending on the country.

name: Candidate Target List
description: A Target List of entities submitted by component commanders, appropriate agencies, or the joint force commander’s staff for further development and inclusion on the joint target list, restricted target list, or the no-strike list.

name: Critical Element Relational Quality
description: A relational quality whereby some element of a target, which if effectively engaged, will serve to support the achievement of an operational objective and/or mission task.

name: Functional Damage Assessment
description: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that provides an estimate of the effect of military force in degrading or destroying the functional or operational capability of the target to perform its intended mission and of the level of success in achieving operational objectives established against the target.

name: Global Integrated Target List
description: A Target List containing a list of targets nominated by CCMDs to support GCP and Global Integrated Framework objectives, whose   purpose in to increase visibility of targets proposed for execution that must be prioritized and synchronized globally and may be executed and/or engaged outside the supported commander’s AOR.

name: Joint Integrated Prioritized Target List
description: A Target List consisting of a prioritized list of targets approved and maintained by the joint force commander.

name: Joint Target List
description: A Target List consisting of a consolidated list of selected targets, upon which there are no restrictions placed and considered to have military significance in the joint force commander’s operational area.

name: Physical Damage Assessment
description: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity where the estimate of the quantitative extent of physical damage to a target resulting from the application of military force.

name: Restricted Target List
description: A Target List containing a list of restricted targets nominated by elements of the joint force and approved by the joint force commander or directed by higher authorities.

name: Strike Restriction
description: A process prohibition that expresses a restriction on target engagement that was specified during the target validation process.

name: Target Designator
description: A Designative information content entity assigning an entity with the role of a target.

name: Target Folder
description: An information bearing artifact that carries information about target intelligence and related materials prepared for planning and executing actions against a specific target.

name: Target Legal Assessment
description: A process regulation that consists of an assessment of whether an object meets the legal criteria requirements to be a target.

name: Target Legal Assessment Entry
description: A target folder entry that records a Target Legal Assessment.

name: Target List
description: A Directive Information Content Entity containing a consolidated list of selected targets considered to have military significance in the combatant commanders area of responsibility.

name: Target Nomination List
description: A Target List consisting of a prioritized list of targets drawn from the joint target list and nominated by component commanders, appropriate agencies, or the joint force commander’s staff for inclusion on the joint integrated prioritized target list.

name: Target Number
description: A Code Identifier which designates an entity for consideration for engagement or other action.

name: Target Role
description: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent as having been identified by some appropriate authority for possible engagement or other action.

name: Target Validation
description: An action permission that affirms that a target specification meets the objectives and criteria outlined in the commander’s guidance and complies with the law of war and rules of engagement.

name: Target Vetting Assessment
description: A descriptive information content entity that supports the assessment of accuracy of intelligence by a defense-related agency.

name: target vetting assessment entry
description: A target folder entry that assesses the accuracy of the supporting intelligence for targeting.

name: entity
description: (Elucidation) An entity is anything that exists or has existed or will exist

name: continuant
description: (Elucidation) A continuant is an entity that persists, endures, or continues to exist through time while maintaining its identity

name: occurrent
description: (Elucidation) An occurrent is an entity that unfolds itself in time or it is the start or end of such an entity or it is a temporal or spatiotemporal region

name: independent continuant
description: b is an independent continuant =Def b is a continuant which is such that there is no c such that b s-depends on c and no c such that b g-depends on c

name: spatial region
description: (Elucidation) A spatial region is a continuant entity that is a continuant part of the spatial projection of a portion of spacetime at a given time

name: temporal region
description: (Elucidation) A temporal region is an occurrent over which processes can unfold

name: two-dimensional spatial region
description: (Elucidation) A two-dimensional spatial region is a spatial region that is a whole consisting of a surface together with zero or more surfaces and/or spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

name: spatiotemporal region
description: (Elucidation) A spatiotemporal region is an occurrent that is an occurrent part of spacetime

name: process
description: (Elucidation) p is a process means p is an occurrent that has some temporal proper part and for some time t, p has some material entity as participant at t

name: disposition
description: (Elucidation) b is a disposition means: b is a realizable entity & b is such that if it ceases to exist, then its bearer is physically changed, & b's realization occurs when and because this bearer is in some special physical circumstances, & this realization occurs in virtue of the bearer's physical make-up

name: realizable entity
description: (Elucidation) b is a realizable entity means: b is a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in some independent continuant which is not a spatial region and is of a type some instances of which are realized in processes of a correlated type

name: zero-dimensional spatial region
description: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional spatial region is one or a collection of more than one spatially disjoint points in space

name: quality
description: (Elucidation) a quality is a specifically dependent continuant that, in contrast to roles and dispositions, does not require any further process in order to be realized

name: specifically dependent continuant
description: b is a specifically dependent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is some independent continuant c which is not a spatial region & which is such that b s-depends on c

name: role
description: (Elucidation) b is a role means: b is a realizable entity & b exists because there is some single bearer that is in some special physical, social, or institutional set of circumstances in which this bearer does not have to be & b is not such that, if it ceases to exist, then the physical make-up of the bearer is thereby changed

name: fiat object part
description: (Elucidation) a fiat object part b is a material entity which is such that for all times t, if b exists at t then there is some object c such that b is a proper continuant part of c at t and b is demarcated from the remainder of c by one or more fiat surfaces

name: one-dimensional spatial region
description: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a line together with zero or more lines and/or points as parts

name: object aggregate
description: (Elucidation) an object aggregate is a material entity consisting exactly of a plurality (≥1) of objects as member parts which together form a unit

name: three-dimensional spatial region
description: (Elucidation) A three-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a spatial volume together with zero or more spatial volumes and/or spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

name: site
description: (Elucidation) b is a site means: b is a three-dimensional immaterial entity whose boundaries either (1) (partially or wholly) coincide with the boundaries of one or more material entities or (2) have locations determined in relation to some material entity

name: object
description: (Elucidation) an object is a material entity which manifests causal unity & is of a type instances of which are maximal relative to the sort of causal unity manifested

name: generically dependent continuant
description: (Elucidation) a generically dependent continuant is an entity that exists in virtue of the fact that there is at least one of what may be multiple copies; it is the content or the pattern that the multiple copies share

name: function
description: (Elucidation) A function is a disposition that exists in virtue of the bearer's physical make-up and this physical make-up is something the bearer possesses because it came into being either through evolution (in the case of natural biological entities) or through intentional design (in the case of artefacts), in order to realize processes of a certain sort

name: process boundary
description: p is a process boundary =Def p is a temporal part of a process & p has no proper temporal parts

name: one-dimensional temporal region
description: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region is a whole that has a temporal interval and zero or more temporal intervals and temporal instants as parts

name: material entity
description: (Elucidation) A material entity is an independent continuant that at all times at which it exists has some portion of matter as continuant part

name: continuant fiat boundary
description: (Elucidation) b is a continuant fiat boundary means: b is an immaterial entity that is of zero, one or two dimensions, which is such that there is no time t when b has a spatial region as continuant part at t, and whose location is determined in relation to some material entity

name: immaterial entity
description: a is an immaterial entity =Def a is an independent continuant which is such that there is no time t when it has a material entity as continuant part at t

name: fiat line
description: (Elucidation) a fiat line is a one-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is continuous

name: relational quality
description: b is a relational quality =Def b is a quality and there exists c and d such that b and c are not identical, & b s-depends on c & b s-depends on d

name: fiat surface
description: (Elucidation) a fiat surface is a two-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is self-connected

name: fiat point
description: (Elucidation) a fiat point is a zero-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that consists of a single point

name: zero-dimensional temporal region
description: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole consisting of one or more separated temporal instants as parts

name: history
description: (Elucidation) A history is a process that is the sum of the totality of processes taking place in the spatiotemporal region occupied by the material part of a material entity

name: temporal interval
description: (Elucidation) a temporal interval is a one-dimensional temporal region that is continuous, thus without gaps or breaks

name: temporal instant
description: (Elucidation) a temporal instant is a zero-dimensional temporal region that has no proper temporal part

name: Acoustic Sensor
description: A sensor that is designed to detect pressure waves made by the propagation of a sound vibration(s) in gases, liquids, or solids.

name: Air Vehicle
description: A vehicle capable of atmospheric flight due to interaction with the air, such as buoyancy or lift.

name: Anti-tank Weapon
description: A weapon that has an anti-tank function.

name: Armored Ground Vehicle
description: A standardized armored ground vehicle that consists of an integrated engine, transmission, driveshaft, suspension, and tracks, which are enclosed in an armored hull to which is mounted alternative mission-specific systems (for example: anti-tank weapon, ammunition resupply equipment, field artillery, engineering equipment).

name: Command Control and Communication System
description: A system that that is capable of command, control, and communications.

name: Command and Control System
description: A command and control system that is an assembly of equipment, methods and procedures and, if necessary, personnel, that enables commanders and their staffs to exercise command and control.

name: Depth Charge Launcher
description: A weapon that is used as a computer-controlled mortar that can fire depth chargers away from a ship.

name: Electronic Warfare Support Equipment
description: Electronic warfare equipment that is used to search for, intercept, identify, and locate or localize sources of intentional and unintentional radiated electromagnetic energy for the purpose of immediate threat recognition, targeting, planning and conduct of future operations.

name: Electronic Warfare Equipment
description: A material artifact that is equipment used in electronic warfare.

name: Electro-Optical Equipment
description: Electronic devices which operate by the propagation and interaction of light with various tailored materials.

name: Engineering Equipment
description: A material artifact specially designed to execute construction tasks, involving earthwork operations or other large construction tasks.

name: Fixed Wing Aircraft
description: An air vehicle that uses wings that generate lift caused by the aircraft's forward airspeed and the shape of the wings.

name: Grenade Launcher
description: A projectile-firing light weapon that launches a specially-designed bomb (for example: fragmentation grenade) with longer range and greater accuracy of impact than can be achieved if the bomb were thrown by hand.

name: Artillery Piece
description: A weapon that has an artillery function.

name: Microwave Equipment
description: A radio communication instrument that uses specialized equipment to transmit and receive radio frequency over long distances without the use of wires or cables.

name: Missile Launcher Vehicle
description: A missile ground vehicle that is used to launch missiles.

name: Missile System
description: A system that uses rocket propulsion to deliver explosive warheads to targets.

name: Mobile Station
description: A mobile station that is intended to be mobilized by part of a vehicle to provide that station's capability at a location.

name: Naval Gun
description: A tube-launched projectile-firing weapon that is mounted on a warship.

name: Naval Surface Vessel
description: A surface vessel that is used by a naval force in a body of water.

name: Continuant Aggregate
description: A Continuant consisting exactly of a plurality (>1) of Continuants as component parts which together form a unit.

name: Engineered System
description: A System that has some of its component parts, and some of the interactions between its component parts, prescribed by some Directive Information Content Entity so that the component parts realize some realizable entity to contribute to achieving some Objective.

name: Fiat Material Part
description: A fiat material part b is a material entity & such that if b exists then it is continuant part of some material entity c & demarcated from the remainder of c by one or more fiat surfaces.

name: Logical Interface
description: A Material Interface that has continuant parts at least two Material Fiat Surfaces that (i) are each a continuant part of some System Element; (ii) flow interface with one another by exchanging some information carrier.

name: Material Fiat Surface
description: A Material Fiat Part that is co-located with some Fiat Surface.

name: Material Interface
description: A Fiat Material Part that has continuant parts at least two Material Fiat Surfaces that (i) are each a continuant part of some System Element; (ii) interface with one another.

name: Physical Interface
description: A Material Interface that has continuant parts at least two Material Fiat Surfaces that (i) are each a continuant part of some System Element; (ii) physically interface with one another.

name: System
description: A Continuant Aggregate such that each component part interacts with at least one other component part.

name: System Component
description: A component part of some System.

name: System Element
description: An element of some System.

name: Target folder graphic
description: An image that depicts a certain type of information relevant to the target development process by means of a graphical format specified in guidance.

name: Aimpoint Specification
description: A directive information content entity that associates a point with a target and is assigned for a specific weapon impact.

name: battle damage assessment
description: An estimate information content entity that provides an assessment of the damage resulting from the application of lethal or nonlethal military force.

name: Optical Equipment
description: An artifact that is equipment that deals with the genesis and propagation of light, the changes that it undergoes and produces, and other phenomena closely associated with it.

name: collateral damage assessment
description: An estimate information content entity that provides an assessment of collateral damage resulting from the application of lethal or nonlethal military force during a target engagement.

name: collateral damage estimate
description: An estimate information content entity that describes the potential for collateral damage that would result from a target engagement.

name: collateral damage estimate entry
description: A target folder entry that records a Collateral Damage Estimate.

name: Collateral Damage Estimate graphic
description: A Target Folder Graphic that visually depicts the output of a collateral damage estimate and assists engagement authorities in weighing risk against military necessity and assessing proportionality within the framework of the JPP.

name: combat assessment
description: A descriptive information content entity that consists of an asssessment of the overall effectiveness of force employment during a military operation.

name: Radar
description: A sensor that uses radio waves to detect and determine the range, altitude, direction, and/or speed of both moving and fixed objects (for example: aircraft, ships, motor vehicles, weather formations, and terrain).

name: Critical target element graphic
description: A Target Folder Graphic depiction that identifies a feature or part of a target that enables it to perform a function and, if effectively engaged, should achieve the commander's objective or create a significant effect on the target.

name: Facility outline graphic
description: A Target Folder Graphic depiction that provides the authoritative outline for a facility of interest for the targeting community.

name: Radio Communication System
description: A radio communication instrument that is used to carry information across space with radio waves.

name: Rotary Wing Aircraft
description: An air vehicle whose lift is derived from the aerodynamic forces acting on one or more powered rotors turning about substantially vertical axes.

name: joint desired point of impact
description: An aimpoint specification that associates a three-dimensional mensurated coordinate with a target to achieve an explicit weaponeering objective.

name: Joint Desired Point Of Impact graphic
description: A Target Folder Graphic that couples mensurated data with detailed visual intelligence to support the employment of precision weapons.

name: RPV Ground Control Station
description: A mobile station that allows operators to communicate with and control a drone.

name: Surface-to-Air Missile System
description: A missile system consisting of surface-to-air missile(s), launcher(s), sensor(s), and integrated electronic equipment for target acquisition, aiming, or fire control, or a combination of such purposes.

name: munitions effectiveness assessment
description: An estimate information content entity that compares the actual effectiveness of the weapons systems and/or munitions employed in a target engagement to their anticipated effectiveness calculated during the capability analysis phase of the joint targeting cycle.

name: No Strike List
description: A process prohibition containing a list of objects or entities characterized as protected from the effects of military operations under international law and/or rules of engagement.

name: Small Arms
description: A weapon that is a firearm or gun that can expel or launch a shot, bullet, or projectile by action of explosive.

name: Reattack Recommendation
description: A process regulation, derived from the results of BDA and munitions effectiveness assessment, that provides the commander systematic advice on re-attack of targets.

name: Thermal Imaging System
description: A Electro-Optical Equipment that has a Thermal Imaging Artifact Function.

name: Trailer Vehicle
description: A non-self-powered ground vehicle that is designed to carry cargo and to be towed by another vehicle.

name: strike restriction entry
description: A target folder entry that records a Strike Restriction.

name: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
description: A powered, air vehicle that does not carry a human operator, uses aerodynamic forces to provide vehicle lift, can fly autonomously or be piloted remotely, can be expendable or recoverable, and can carry a lethal or non-lethal payload. NOTE: ballistic or semi ballistic vehicles, cruise missiles, and artillery projectiles are not considered unmanned aerial vehicles.

name: Unmanned Ground Vehicle
description: A ground vehicle without a human driver aboard that is guided through its tasks either remotely or autonomously (that is, by an internal computer program).

name: Anti-tank Function
description: An anti-armor function that is designed to destroy or check tanks.

name: Mobile Bridge
description: A bridge that has a mobile transport mode.

name: Station
description: A material artifact consisting of a container, module or shelter containing all equipment necessary to perform a specific function.

name: Lighter than Air Vehicle
description: An air vehicle that gains its lift through using a buoyant gas.

name: Subsurface Vessel
description: A watercraft that operates on the surface of the water without a crew.

name: Surface Vessel
description: A watercraft that is designed for operation on the marine surface, as distinguished from a submarine or other types of vessels.

name: Air Drop Device
description: A military support device that is designed to facilitate the release and/or guidance of cargo, devices, or personnel from an airborne aircraft with the purpose of delivering them to the ground in operating condition.

name: Target Validation Authority role
description: An authority role whose bearer is authorized to affirm that a candidate target meets the criteria and conditions necessary to be added to a restricted target list or joint target list.

name: target validation entry
description: A target folder entry that records a Target Validation.

name: Mine Delivery Device
description: A military support device that is designed to dispense landmines for tactical emplacement.

name: Medical Device
description: A healthcare device that is designed to be used for the treatment or prevention of a specific physical ailment.

name: Surface-to-Surface Missile System
description: A system consisting of missile(s) and launcher(s) designed to launch guided missiles from the ground or the sea and strike targets on land or at sea.

name: Mine Operations Device
description: A military support device that is designed to defeat armor-piercing (AP) and/or anti-tank (AT) landmines through detection, removal, destruction, detonation, deception, or disruption.

name: Autonomous System Number Address
description: A Code Identifier that designates the Autonomous System routing protocol that the Internet Protocol is using.

name: Basic Service Set
description: A Computer Network that consists of Computing Devices that are wirelessly connected using a MLME-JOIN request as defined in IEEE 802.11.

name: Basic Service Set Identifier
description: A Service Set Identifier that designates some Basic Service Set.

name: Computer System Resource
description: A Resource that is part of a Computer System and allows it to run processes and store digital information.

name: Emulation Process
description: A Computer Program Execution during which some Computing Device replicates the behavior of some Hardware or Software.

name: Extended Service Set
description: A Computer Network that has one or more Infrastructure Basic Service Set as parts.

name: Extended Service Set Identifier
description: A Service Set Identifier that designates an Extended Service Set.

name: Independent Service Set
description: A Basic Service Set that is connected from Computing Device to Computing Device, rather than a common Wireless Network Access Point.

name: Infrastructure Basic Service Set
description: A Basic Service Set that is connected through a Wireless Network Access Point.

name: Internet Protocol v4 Address
description: An Internet Protocol Address according to the Internet Protocol Address v4 specification.

name: Internet Protocol v6 Address
description: An Internet Protocol Address according to the Internet Protocol Address v6 specification.

name: Service Set Identifier
description: A Code Identifier that designates any Service Set.

name: Virtual Local Area Network
description: A Local Area Network that connects devices over the Internet.

name: Virtual Local Area Network Identifier
description: A Code Identifier that designates a Virtual Local Area Network.

name: Virtual Machine Computer Program
description: A Computer Program Artifact Model that directs the execution of an Emulation Process with Computer System Resources made available during a Virtualization Process.

name: Virtualization Process
description: A Computer Program Execution that partitions and manages some Computer System Resources.

name: Virtualization Software Model
description: A Computer Program Artifact Model that directs a Virtualization Process.

name: Wireless Network Access Function
description: An Information Processing Artifact function that is realized in processes wherein Computing Devices are able to connect to the same Computer Network.

name: Wireless Network Access Point
description: A Communication Instrument that bears a Wireless Network Access Point Function.

name: Act of Artifact Modification
description: An Act of Artifact Processing in which an existing Artifact is acted upon in a manner that changes, adds, or removes one or more of its Qualities, Dispositions, or Functions.

name: Act of Association
description: A Social Act wherein an Agent unites with some other Agent in a Planned Act, enterprise or business.

name: Act of Measuring
description: A Planned Act that involves determining the extent, dimensions, quanity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.

name: Action Permission
description: A Process Regulation that permits some Process.

name: Process Prohibition
description: A Process Regulation that prohibits some Process.

name: Process Regulation
description: A Directive Information Content Entity that prescribes an Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of an Process which realizes some Authority Role.

name: Process Requirement
description: A Process Regulation that requires some Process.

name: Authority Role
description: A Role that is realized by Processes which create, modify, transfer, or eliminate Process Regulations or other Authority Roles, and inheres in an Agent in virtue of collective acceptance of that Agent's ability to issue binding directives.

name: Bridge
description: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to span physical obstacles without closing the way underneath to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to pass over the obstacles.

name: Communication Instrument
description: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate communication between at least two entities.

name: Ground Motor Vehicle
description: A Ground Vehicle that is designed to receive its motive power from an Engine and is not designed to travel on rails.

name: Image
description: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

name: Land Transportation Artifact
description: A Transportation Artifact that is fixed in place and designed to bear a Function, the realization of which is sometimes part of a process moving Vehicles and Agents from one location to another via land.

name: Missile Launcher
description: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Precision-Guided Missiles.

name: Navigation System
description: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable an Agent or Artifact to determine the position or direction of some object, usually for the purpose of monitoring or controlling the movement of some Vehicle from one place to another.

name: Portion of Ammunition
description: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by being projected toward its target at a significant Velocity.

name: Precision-Guided Missile
description: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled and precision-guided projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances.

name: Predictive Information Content Entity
description: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes an uncertain future event.

name: Projectile Launcher
description: A Weapon that is designed to inflict damage or harm by means of launching a high-velocity projectile at a target.

name: Radio Communication Instrument
description: A Communication Instrument that is designed to enable communication between two or more entities via the use of radio waves.

name: Rocket Launcher
description: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Unguided Rockets.

name: Sensor
description: A Transducer that is designed to convert incoming energy into a output signal which reliably corresponds to changes in that energy.

name: Torpedo
description: A Precision-Guided Missile that is designed to be fired into a body of water, be self-propelled through the water, and carry an explosive payload.

name: Transducer
description: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert one form of energy to another.

name: Transportation Artifact
description: A Material Artifact that is fixed in place and designed to bear a Function, the realization of which is sometimes part of a process moving Vehicles and Agents from one location to another.

name: Truck
description: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to be used to transport cargo.
